module: Grid selector utility: manages filter state ("set" value-set filters and "range" filters), the search text, filter locking and the computation of the active filters list displayed as chips. Backends (vehicles, gameplay, etc.) create an instance via `create`, providing the function that builds the filters from their item list.
notes: A filter is described in filterList by { propName, propKey, type = 'set'|'range', options, min, max }. filterByProp[propName] is { [option] = bool } for a set and { min, max } for a range.
toggleFilter: if all options are enabled, keeps only the clicked option; otherwise toggles the option; if everything becomes false, everything is re-enabled. Locked options are not modified.
BUG: unlockFilter tests `if not lockedFiltersByProp[propName] then lockedFiltersByProp[propName] = nil` (inverted condition): it never unlocks anything. Only clearLockedFilters releases the locks.
Probable BUG: updateFilters tests `type(lockedOptions) == 'table'` while lockedFiltersByProp[propName] is always a table; the "range" branch is never reached.
Caches are invalidated by an internal flag (filtersDirty); passesFilters and getValidFilters recompute validFilters if needed. passesFilters always returns true without customPassesFiltersFunction.
A filter's option can be a table: its value is option.value, otherwise option.id, otherwise option.name.

createFiltersFunction.desc: (configList) -> filterList, filterByProp, commonFilters; called by initializeFilters.

commonFilters.desc: List of { propName, option } pairs considered "common" filters.

rangeFilters.desc: Accepted but unused in the code.

dictFilters.desc: Accepted but unused in the code.

customPassesFiltersFunction.desc: (itemData, validFilters, searchText) -> boolean; used by passesFilters.

initializeFilters.desc: Calls createFiltersFunction(configList) and replaces filterList, filterByProp and optionally commonFilters.

configList.desc: Data passed to the creation function.

getFilters.desc: Returns the full state for the UI.

returns.desc: { filterList, filterByProp, commonFilters, lockedFiltersByProp, activeFilters, onlyCommonFilters }.

getActiveFilters.desc: Returns the list of active filters (displayText, propName, propValue, isActive, iconType, type).

updateFilters.desc: Replaces filterByProp with newFilters while keeping the locked values.

toggleFilter.desc: Toggles an option of a set filter (see notes). Ignored if the option is locked.

updateRangeFilter.desc: Sets min and max of a range filter (ignored if locked).

resetRangeFilter.desc: Resets a range filter to its default bounds.

resetSetFilter.desc: Re-enables all options of a set filter.

clearAllFilters.desc: Resets all range and set filters then clears the search text.

lockFilter.desc: Locks the current state of a filter (range: min/max; set: the given options or all).

unlockFilter.desc: Intended to unlock a filter; has no effect because of a bug (see notes).

isFilterLocked.desc: Returns whether an option (or any option if option is nil) of a property is locked.

lockFilterMode.desc: Locks a filter in a mode: range -> sets the given min/max; set -> all options to false then those of `options` (table option -> bool) to the given value, all locked.

options.desc: {min, max} for range or { [option] = bool } for set.

lockFilterModeExclusive.desc: Set filters only: all options set to false and locked, except those of allowedOptions set to true and unlocked.

calculateActiveFilters.desc: Computes the filters that differ from the default values.

returns.desc: true if there is at least one active non-common filter.

setupValidFilters.desc: Rebuilds the internal list of effectively restrictive filters (used by passesFilters).

getValidFilters.desc: Returns the list of restrictive filters (recomputed if needed).

passesFilters.desc: Tests an item with customPassesFiltersFunction(itemData, validFilters, searchText); true if no function is provided.

setSearchText.desc: Sets the search text (nil becomes "") and invalidates the cache.
